run_condition: Run only if NAAMP_NWI_CONTEXT_ELIGIBILITY_CONTRACT_V0_1 overall feasibility gate passes and both hydroperiod contrast groups have >=200 physically stable unique SiteIDs represented on >=75 routes.
ecological_hypothesis: Rainfall-associated recruitment of route-new calling species is stronger at pulse-limited wetlands than at wetlands with persistent surface water.

excluded_from_primary_contrast.reason: Saturated/mixed, artificial, or tidal regimes do not form the prefixed short-hydroperiod versus persistent-surface-water contrast.

physical_identity: Use only pair x StopNumber rows where wet and dry Runs.csv/Stops.csv records have the same nonmissing SiteID.

response.name: net_route_new_incidence_at_stop
response.gain: Wet-run species present at this stop but not in the dry stop AND absent from the entire dry route.
response.loss: Dry-run species present at this stop but not in the wet stop AND absent from the entire wet route.
response.identity: Summed over ten stops this equals the route-new portion of the four-component net incidence allocation (corner + taxonomic components).

model.design: Within-pair fixed-effects linear model implemented by demeaning outcome and predictors within pair.
model.rationale: Pair fixed effects absorb all pair-level conditions including overall rainfall contrast, temperature/date/year differences and route-season context; the interaction tests whether within the same wet-dry comparison route-new recruitment is preferentially allocated to pulse-limited wetland stops as rainfall contrast increases.

sensitivities.radius_500m: Repeat using nearest NWI polygon within 500m, retaining the same regime groups.
sensitivities.gain_only: Replace net response by wet route-new gain count only; directional diagnostic, not a second pass gate.
sensitivities.exact_consecutive_year: Repeat primary model on year_gap==1; directional diagnostic.

interpretation_boundary: A positive interaction links recruitment to mapped hydroperiod context; it does not prove survey-night inundation or a physiological hydration mediator.
NWI map vintage can differ from NAAMP survey years.
Nearest wetland polygon is a context proxy, not proven call origin.
No RC11 submission change is authorized from this exploration.
